name: chromatic-text
title: Chromatic Text
description: Three-layer scroll-reactive chromatic text with white, red, and blue depth layers.

props.name: baseTextColor
props.description: Color of the front/base text layer.

props.name: firstTextColor
props.description: Color of the red chromatic depth layer.

props.name: secondTextColor
props.description: Color of the blue chromatic depth layer.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Font size in vw units shared by every text layer.

props.name: fontWeight
props.description: Font weight shared by every text layer.

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: Background color for the scroll section.
